info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Top-Level Leafs (Simple Values)
info.description:
All top-level leaf nodes in the Cisco-IOS-XE-native model. These are simple configuration values like hostname, version, config-register, etc. Fast and lightweight - perfect for basic device configuration.

**What's included:** All simple string/boolean/numeric values at /native root level.

**Related:** See 'Top-Level Containers' for complex structures (ip, interface, router, etc.)
